args: Current grasp stage only. Reacquire the same four marks and table AFTER the approach. Assess only the remaining vertical open-finger descent to the recomputed finite-pad contact height. Both finger passages beside the package must be visible and clear of other objects; no closure is requested yet. Request depth points p0,p1,p2,p3 on four uniquely identifiable printed material landmarks of the SAME cream cheese top, and s0,s1,s2 on separated bare local TABLE patches, including the finger approach area. Use whichever current camera genuinely sees each landmark. Table points must be noncollinear and distributed, not bowl, robot or stove. Reidentify precisely the stored four physical print landmarks, with the same p0 through p3 identities. Do not substitute different marks or image quadrants. Historical projections are only hypotheses. Return the stored label descriptions. Report only current visible evidence. passages concerns the two bare descent passages beside the package, not invented hidden wall surfaces. route excludes intended package contact but must include nearby bowl, bottle and table obstacles. If retrying, use the other camera or a genuinely different depth-valid patch for a table point, not the same failed measurement. On initial selection only, a rejected quartet may be replaced as a whole before a reference is established.

labels: p0: Lower-facing terminal of the right-hand curl of the initial large capital C in Cream.
p1: Upper terminal of the first small white subtitle letter inside the blue badge, to the left of the large lettering.
p2: Right-hand curl terminal of the large capital C starting Cheese, distinct from the capital C in Cream.
p3: Bottom terminal stroke of the final lowercase e in Cheese.
reference.identity: Four individually named printed landmarks on the same cream cheese top; not a tracker or arbitrary pixel samples.

result.explanation: The same package remains flat on the table, with open, empty fingers and no visible displacement. p0, p1 and p2 are visible in the wrist camera. p3 is hidden by the robot in that camera but visible at the far printed end in agentview; its image resolution is much lower. Both bare side passages are visible and clear of other objects. The bowl and bottle are outside the remaining local vertical descent. The table is below both passages; use the returned current table measurements to recompute and check the finite-pad endpoint clearance. This review covers only open-finger descent, not closure, retention or transport.
